capabilities: Export a folder of chapter notes to EPUB
Export a Longform project to EPUB in scene order
Embed images and render scene breaks
Add a JPG or PNG cover to the EPUB
extras: EPUB export only; no print-PDF export yet. Non-image note embeds are silently skipped, and nested Longform scenes are flattened into chapters. Longform export is optional; folder export works without it.
intentEvidence: No separate paid tool, no leaving Obsidian.
motivation: The author built it so long-form writers can produce a properly formatted EPUB without a separate paid tool (Vellum, Atticus) or a fragile export chain.
problem: Getting a properly formatted EPUB out of Obsidian normally requires a separate paid tool or a fragile export chain.

relations.evidence: Run "Export Longform project to EPUB" and you get a properly structured EPUB of that project

summary: Plugin that exports an Obsidian book manuscript to a clean EPUB, with one-command export of Longform projects.
